name: Planner - Itinerary
description: Plan together: a day-by-day itinerary that draws in the events, tasks and polls your {space} already has.
author: Coffee Pub

permissions.label: Plan the trip: add, change and move things on it

provides.name: addStop
provides.label: Add it to the trip
provides.description: Add a plain stop to the itinerary, at a saved place if one is given; for a hotel, restaurant, winery, tour or other typed stop use acceptSuggestion with a kind.

inputHints.placeRef: A saved place from Maps (its pointer, as search shows it). The stop then shows that place's name, and its address if the stop has none.
inputHints.time: Start time as HH:MM, 24-hour, for example 14:30.
inputHints.minutes: How long it lasts, in whole minutes, from 1 to 10080; use this or endTime, not both.
inputHints.endTime: End time as HH:MM, which needs a start time; use this or minutes, not both.
inputHints.cost: The estimated cost, a number from 0 in the trip's currency, for example 120.50.
inputHints.notes: The notes. Line breaks are allowed.

provides.name: addToDay
provides.label: Put it on the trip's itinerary
provides.description: Put {an object} that already exists on the trip's itinerary, on the day given if there is one.

provides.name: acceptSuggestion
provides.label: Add it to the trip, properly typed
provides.description: Add a journey, stay or stop by its kind, at a saved place or as a fully typed object.

inputHints.kind: What it is: flight, train, bus, ferry, car, hotel, restaurant, cafe, bar, winery, sight, museum, attraction, tour, show, event or note. Leave out for a plain stop.
inputHints.placeRef: A saved place from Maps, for a stop only. The stop then shows that place's name, and its address if you gave none.
inputHints.time: Start time as HH:MM, 24-hour, for example 14:30; a flight's departure.
inputHints.minutes: How long it lasts, in whole minutes, from 1 to 10080; a stay has no length.
inputHints.cost: The estimated cost, a number from 0 in the trip's currency, for example 120.50.
inputHints.content: The words. Line breaks are allowed.
inputHints.object: { kind, title, details }. A flight's details: airline, number, from and to ({ code, name }), departs, arrives, terminal, gate, seat, class, reference, cost, currency, travellers.

provides.name: setStopPlace
provides.label: Put this stop at a place
provides.description: Put an itinerary stop at a saved place, or take it off its place.

inputHints.stop: The stop to change; only a stop can be at a place.
inputHints.placeRef: A saved place from Maps. Leave out to take the stop off its place; its name stays.

provides.name: updatePlan
provides.label: Change an itinerary entry
provides.description: Change only the fields given of a journey, stay, stop or note already on the itinerary, with typed details in object.

inputHints.entry: The entry to change, its pointer as search or an earlier answer gives it.
inputHints.object: A patch { kind, title, details }; the entry's own kind and title keep them. A flight's details: airline, number, from, to, departs, arrives, terminal, gate, seat, class, reference, cost, travellers.
inputHints.title: The new title.
inputHints.time: Start time as HH:MM, 24-hour, for example 14:30; a flight's departure. "" clears it.
inputHints.minutes: How long it lasts, in whole minutes, from 1 to 10080; use this or endTime, not both. "" clears it.
inputHints.endTime: End time as HH:MM; it is measured from the start time given, else the entry's own.
inputHints.cost: The estimated cost, a number from 0 in the trip's currency, for example 120.50. "" clears it.
inputHints.notes: The notes, which replace the old ones. Line breaks are allowed. "" clears them.
inputHints.placeRef: A saved place from Maps, for a stop only. The stop then shows that place's name, and its address if it has none.

provides.name: addFromText
provides.label: Add to the trip from text

provides.name: deletePlan
provides.label: Delete an itinerary entry
provides.description: Delete one stop, journey, stay or note from the itinerary.

settings.label: Markers
settings.help: The markers a plan draws: the four automatic ones (their label, icon and colour can change), and the ones people add -- on a day at a time (a time block, such as free time), on a whole day (a tag in its header, such as a travel day), or on the line between days.

settings.label: Suggest flights from earlier trips
settings.help: Fill a flight from the same flight number saved before on this server. Flights saved here also help others; turn this off to keep them out.

settings.label: Weather
settings.help: Where the weather on each day comes from. None: no weather is shown and nothing is sent out.

options.label: Open-Meteo, the public service
options.help:
The server asks api.open-meteo.com for the weather near each day's place: a position rounded to about 1 km and the days, never a name, {a space} or a person.
Open-Meteo's free use is for non-commercial use only; a server that charges needs their paid plan or its own service.

options.label: My own address
options.help: The weather is asked at the address you give below: an Open-Meteo-compatible service you run or may use.

settings.label: Weather address
settings.help: The address of an Open-Meteo-compatible service (for example https://weather.example.org/v1/forecast).

settings.label: Weather key
settings.help: A key for the service, if it needs one. Open-Meteo's free use is for non-commercial use only.

settings.label: Weather temperatures
settings.help: Show temperatures in Celsius or Fahrenheit.
